summary: Loading a prepared V's parts: reuse from the pool, fetch, verify, decode, build materials, upload in slices, then swap in one step.
work: Loads every part the record names that the pool doesn't already hold, and swaps the new set into the scene.
cancel: A newer record supersedes it; parts already built stay in the pool.
cleanup: Unclaimed parts wait in the pool until another V clears it.
lane: page, the person's own; uploads sliced across frames

x-friction.gap: The default V is about 100 MB over 80 files, fetched and decoded by reference.
x-friction.closes: Blob references with a residence and a demand-bound lifetime.
